messages:
Sam: Quick question — can we delete customer-789 debug traces older than 90 days from s3 (trace-logs/customer-789)? Legal flagged retention for that account and wants tidy-up, but I don't want to break any active investigations. Who needs to sign off?

Marta (sec): Please don't delete yet. Do we have any retention hold or open support ticket referencing those traces? If not, we need approvals from Privacy + SRE and an audit entry. Also check if there's a copy in trace-archive.

Lee: There's a copy in trace-archive (glacier) from Jan 2025. Deleting from the active bucket won't remove the archive copy. For a one-off purge I can run a CLI job, but I need a JIRA ticket + written approvals.

Jia (privacy): From privacy: confirm there are no ongoing DSARs or legal holds. If none, I'm fine approving the one-off deletion. Please include the case id and reason in the ticket.

Sam: There's no DSAR. Support ticket #4521 referenced this and it's closed. I'll open a Jira and paste it here.

Lee: Command (dry-run) I'll use:
```sh
aws s3 rm s3://trace-logs/customer-789 --recursive --exclude '*' --include 'traces/*' --dryrun
```
After dry-run and approvals we'll run without `--dryrun` and capture CLI output to `/var/log/purges/customer-789-1987654321.log` and upload to S3 audit bucket.

Alex (privacy): I need the JIRA link and a confirmation there's no regulatory hold. Also confirm whether billing or analytics need the traces preserved for reconciliation.

Sam: JIRA created: INFRA-9987 https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-9987. Added support #4521 and rationale. @Alex (privacy) can you add an approval comment so Lee can proceed?

Alex (privacy): Approved: "privacy approval granted — no holds" :thumbsup:

sec-bot: Audit note created: purge-request INFRA-9987 by Sam at 1987654400

Lee: Running dry-run now, will post output. ETA ~10m.

Lee: dry-run complete — 12 objects matched. snippet:
```text
(dryrun) delete: s3://trace-logs/customer-789/traces/abc.log
(dryrun) delete: s3://trace-logs/customer-789/traces/def.log
(dryrun) delete: s3://trace-logs/customer-789/traces/ghi.log
... total 12 objects
```
If no objections I'll execute for real in 30m and push logs to `s3://audit-purges/customer-789/1987654321.log`.

Marta (sec): Add sec review stamp after execution and ensure the audit object includes the CLI output, the JIRA link, and approver usernames. Also update the retention dashboard so counts reflect the deletion.

Sam: No objections. Thanks all :rocket:
